characters.name: Labrazio
characters.description: Karmic Death: Goon bashed his brains out with a rock when he not only got the Goon's aunt Kizzie killed, but mocked her death in front of him. No Sympathy: When Kizzie is shot to death by the police in the crossfire, he mocks her as a "stupid broad" for putting herself in harm's way to try and protect the Goon, who was standing next to Labrazio when the police started shooting.

characters.name: The Goon
characters.description: Curse: Played for laughs; whenever the Goon attempts to eat a pork chop,a magical goblinnamed Mac Giolla Bhride will teleport to his side from the faerie lands and throw it in a mud puddle. The story "An Irish Wake" explains this is due to a vendetta between the two. Dark and Troubled Past: His mother split on his father and left the baby Goon with him; his father promptly dumped him on his Aunt Kizzie, telling her that the alternative would be going with his original plan and drowning Goon in the river. Then his Aunt Kizzie was killed in a crossfire between the police and the gangster Labrazio. Then Isabella, the first girl he ever loved, broke his heart and left him after he got his face maimed and his eye blinded saving her from the Chinese mob boss Xiang Yao. Then all the crap in the series happens. Despair Event Horizon: Invoked in the final volumes.The Arab's plans are to push Goon beyond his ability to tolerate heartbreak anymore, which he believes will fuel the curse on the town and make him all but godlike in power. Does Not Like Spam: Goonhatesthe smell of sauerkraut, and will threaten bodily harm towards anybody dumb enough to eat it in his presence. Dragon Ascendant: Goon used to claim he was just Labrazio's #1 muscle, whilst secretly running the organization.

characters.name: Franky
characters.description: Ax-Crazy: Becomes this once Rockso introduces him to cocaine in theMetalocalypsecrossover comic. Eye Scream: Franky's favorite means of fighting people who are bigger than he is consists of stabbing them in the eye with his knife. Heroic Comedic Sociopath: Frankie is a sexually depraved, psychotic, hair-trigger murderous maniac, but also Goon's staunchly loyal best friend, and his blood-thirsty antics are played for laughs. Heterosexual Life-Partners: Though their sexuality is firmly established as heterosexual, Goon and Franky are best buds, always hang out together and their friendship has proven stronger than any relationship either of them has tried to have. Lovable Sex Maniac: Franky is the most unashamedly horndog member of the cast, but it's played for laughs.

characters.name: Buzzard
characters.description: Complete Immortality: After the Priest cursed him with eternal undeath, Buzzard cannot be killed by anything at all, be it aging or mortal wounds. Naturally,this got old after a while, though it also means Buzzard can win almost any fight he puts himself in as long as he isn't overpowered and imprisoned. Later it's revealed that something has happened to Buzzard that means even the Priest can't remove the curse. The Cowl: He dresses in a black wide-brimmed hat andBadass Longcoat, he haunts cemeteries and he literally cannot die, which leads to him acting as a vigilante of the night. The Gunslinger: He primarily wieldstwo pistols in close quarters, but he also has a longer-range rifle at his disposal. Horror Hunger: He gets his adoptive name based on how he has an unnatural craving for the flesh of corpses, making him a scavenger akin to a buzzard. My Greatest Failure: His sad backstory is that when the Priest came to his town and started turning people into zombies, he was too saddened by how quickly the Priest was able to turn the townsfolk against him to come to their rescue. Now he's been haunted by their deaths ever since.

characters.name: The Mudd Brothers
characters.description: Companion Cube: When Bill Mudd dies, Charley starts carrying around a tree stump as if it were his brother's disembodied head, owing to how Bill's head already looked like a tree stump. The Dividual: They're almost never seen apart from each other and are usually referred to as a package deal.

characters.name: Merle
characters.description: Fair-Weather Friend: Merle never appears to hold any true allegiance to Goon or anyone else in Norton's Pub. In his very first appearance he tries to cash in the bounty on Goon's head. Nevetheless, he serves as a capable ally for the first handful of story arcs. The Mole: He turns out to have sold out the location of the Mudd Brothers to Labrazio, resulting in them getting whacked. For the betrayal, Goon tortures him violently for an entire night and then shoots him in the head with a silver bullet.

characters.name: Willy Nagel
characters.description: Dark and Troubled Past: Revealed in the second-to-last volume: his father was anabusivepreacherwhose behavior drove his kinder, gentler son to pack up and hit the road. He hitchhiked all over America until he met a girl and fell in love with her. But she had a suitor, a big mean ape of a man who, with a friend, caught the girl in a barn and brutally raped & killed her before pinning her death on Nagel. He escaped being lynched, then crept back and murdered the two men responsible - but he got caught standing over the former suitor in his home and was gunned down, going to his grave accused of all three murders. Then the Zombie Preacher's magic happened to bring him back as a "talker". Our Zombies Are Different: He's a magically reanimated corpse who retains his full consciousness and identity. He may need to eat regular amounts of meat, but he sates it with normal meat, rather than chewing on people. Token Heroic Orc: He's the only Slack Jaw seen anywhere in the entire story who isn't a thrall under the control of the Nameless Man, and therefore not a part of the Lonely Street Gang. He ends up proving an invaluable ally to Goon and company.

characters.name: Spider
characters.description: Accidental Hero: He inadvertently provides the key to breaking Goon's curse from Mac Giolla Bhride in issue #14 of the 2019 run, when he tells Mac Bhride about the concept of diners that serve "meat and threes" and confirms that Mac Bhride can have three sides of potatoes. Card Sharp: He regularly cheats at card games and scams the other patrons of Norton's, which means Goon has very little patience for him. Disappeared Dad:Played for Laughs. Spider apparently has an ex and a whole host of spiderlings who walked out on him, which Goon uses as leverage at one point. A Dog Named "Dog": Parodied. "Spider" is a real-world nickname that some people go by, except that Spider is introduced as an actual talkingGiant Spider. His real name is Percival Goodbody. The Friend Nobody Likes: No one at Norton's actually seems to value Spider's company, only ever barely tolerating him. This is owed to the fact that he's a known card sharp and a notorious deadbeat who constantly gets loans he can't pay back, who consequently brings trouble wherever he goes.

characters.name: The Zombie Priest
characters.description: Arch-Enemy: He's the Goon's primary villain, as their two gangs each constantly attempt to wipe out the other andTake Over the City. The Priest has the edge in that he can reanimate corpses, so he never has to worry about his numbers being depleted for long. Eye Scream: Over the course of the story, both of his eyes end up getting ripped out of his head to the point where he's completely blind. He gets one eye back by replacing it with one of his cat minion's eyes. Genuine Human Hide: He wears the flayed face of an old colleague of his named Jinofri on his hat as some sort of awful trophy. Jackass Genie: As a demon-witch-fairy, this is his specialty. When robbed of his gang and left on the streets, he gets by through granting "wishes" to people who come to see him as "Mr. Corpus", though the wishes he grants are often horribly warped and based onExact Words. For example, a man whoWanted a Son Insteadis assured that his next child will not be a daughter. It isn't—it's a nightmarish six-eyed dog monster. Necromancer: What makes the priest so dangerous is that he's a heavy practicioner ofBlack Magic, which allows him to regularly create an army of zombies from the corpses Houstus Grave brings him. Sometimes he goes out of his way to make even deadlier monsters like the Zombie Chimp.

characters.name: Lazlo
characters.description: Servile Snarker: Even as a minion of the Priest, he's usually pretty sardonic whenever the Priest's plans fail.

characters.name: Houstus Grave
characters.description: The Igor: Grave and his sons are the ones who go around town digging up bodies for the Zombie Priest to resurrect, and Houstus himself is heavily deformed by a rare kind of leprosy from his family's curse.

characters.name: Joey the Ball
characters.description: Asymetrically Jacked: His bowling ball arm is far more comically ripped than his other arm, due to having a bowling all on the end of it. Death by Irony: Joey the Ball likes to kill people by crushing their skulls with his bowling ball.Charley Mudd crushes his skull with a stump after Joey kills his brother, Bill Mudd.

characters.name: Mirna
characters.description: The Chanteuse: She's a very pretty dame who regularly sings depressing songs at Norton's and tries to get the Goon's attention. The Schlub Pub Seduction Deduction: Goon is convinced that the only reasons she would be coming on to a chimp-faced guy like him is if she wants something from him, and lashes out at her because of it. Later she admits she was only taking pity on him.

characters.name: El Lagarto Hombre
characters.description: Bilingual Bonus: El Hombre del Largarto is quite talkative, but all of his dialogue is in Spanish. If you don't speak a lick of the stuff this is just a silly gag of incongruity. If you do, it establishes that he's actually pretty smart.

characters.name: Peaches Valentine
characters.description: Toilet Humor: The be-all, end-all of his existence is to laugh at his stupidity and poop obsession.

characters.name: Mac Giolla Bhride
characters.description: Evil Is Petty: Spends the entirety of the series' canon teleporting to the Goon's side and throwing any pork chops he wants to eat into dirt and mud puddles.After being angered by the Duck Boy, Mac Bhride steals his duck and makes a big show of using the duck to wipe his butt, to Duck Boy's horror. Evil Versus Evil:After the Duck Boy burns down the diner that the Goon was supposed to treat Mac Bhride to dinner at, Mac Bhride swears vengeance upon the Duck Boy. I'm a Humanitarian: Loves eating human flesh, though he is willing to agree to wait until the person he wants to eat has died of old age before he claims their body. When the Goon outright asks him how they can square things up so Mac Bhride will call off his curse, Mac Bhride's first impulse is to ask if he can eat Franky. The Necromancer: Issue #14 of the 2019 run establishes he has a hulking Irish bog mummy as a minion, which he created from a man who made the mistake of trying to capture him.Mac Bhride: You Egyptian fellas think yer the only ones that ever knew nothin' about mummification, do ya? Say hello to Killian Clonycavan, the meanest dosser to ever roam the hills of Ireland! Back in the year 392 B.C. I drowned him in a bog meself after he tried to catch me in a butter crock. Now knock him in the gob, Killian! Our Goblins Are Different: He's an Irish goblin with a love of human flesh, and essentially aDarker and Edgiertwist on the iconic leprechaun. He even implies he has leprechaun ancestry in the 2019 run's 14th issue, although he clarifies that he has far more clurichaun heritage from his father's side of the family tree. He hasSuper-Strengthand can teleport.
